## What were you trying to do?

Try a [first-use task](https://github.com/berkebasbay/loopset/blob/main/docs/FEEDBACK.md), or describe your own goal. You do not need to understand the code.

## Where did you get stuck?

Which step, words or control were confusing? What did you expect to happen?

## How far did you get?

Did you finish on your own, finish with help, or stop? What would have helped?

## Environment (if known)

Browser, device or screen size, and app version. A screenshot or a small invented example is optional. Do not share personal/customer data, credentials or browser files.
